_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes: Closing now waits for native and fleet worker completion, cancels partial update downloads, and suppresses late update callbacks. Active simulator recordings stay protected until Stop sweep; session logs finalize before exit. SysID results recheck retained measurements before displaying qualification. Firmware and calibration remain unchanged. Controller startup, hold landing and cuff/fleet transfer are not yet qualified.
